name: Pamir Kabob House
notes: Own site, full plain-HTML priced menu (no JS platform). Footer address '737 Pearl St., La Jolla, CA' matches batch address '737 Pearl Street #110'. Sections from the source: Lunch Specials, Starters/Sides (Cold Appetizers, Sides, Hot Appetizers), Kabobs, Beef Dishes, Plant-Based Dishes, Qorma Dishes (Stew), Chef's Special, Desserts, Beverages, Beer & Wine (Wine by the Glass, White Wines by sub-varietal, Red Wines by sub-varietal). Qorma dishes are priced by protein choice (Lamb $22.95 / Chicken $20.95) applied uniformly across the stew names listed under that header -- each recorded as two rows. Dropped QABELI PALOW from the Qorma list: unlike its siblings its description never mentions meat ('seasoned basmati rice...topped with carrots and raisins'), so the lamb/chicken price split does not clearly apply and no independent price is given -- rather than guess, it is omitted. Where a wine lists only a glass or only a bottle price, only that one row is recorded (not both). Dropped 'Split Plate $8' and 'Cake Cutting Charge $10' as service fees, not food/drink items.
